title: Derinkuyu underground city found by a man renovating his home
summary: Matt tells of Derinkuyu underground city found by a man renovating his home, about discovery within the last 40 years at Derinkuyu, Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he's he's basically working on his apartment and he knocks a wall down accidentally and he opens up this doorway opening

plain: A guest named Matt, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, tells how Derinkuyu, a huge ancient underground city in Turkey, was found. He says a man working on his home accidentally knocked down a wall and opened up a doorway into it. The story is told to show how much of the ancient past may still lie hidden right under people's feet.
